name: n-Dimensional Sparse Voxel Tree (nD SVT)
definition: A generalization of Sparse Voxel Octrees to n-dimensional grids, constructed using Space Filling Curves (SFCs) like Morton or Hilbert curves to linearize n-dimensional data.
summary: The n-Dimensional Sparse Voxel Tree generalizes Sparse Voxel Octrees to higher dimensions, trading increased per-node complexity for significantly reduced tree depth and a more compact binary representation of voxelized scenes.
